start: Active workout on Android, rest running after Bench Press set 2, app in the background, set 3 has grey hint numbers

user_sees: A card 'Rest 1:30 · ends …' with 'Next: Bench Press, set 3' and buttons 'Done', '+15 s', 'Skip'
must_not: A card that cannot be swiped away
A set already done named as next

user_sees: Set 3 saved with the numbers the card showed; a new rest starts and the card names set 4
must_not: Numbers other than the ones shown

start: Rest card in the shade, 1:00 left

user_sees: The end time moves 15 seconds later
The card goes; no 'Rest is over' rings

start: Rest is over alert on the lock screen

user_sees: The named set saved and the next rest started
must_not: The phone unlocking or the app opening for a set that could be saved

start: Rest card copied to the Wear OS watch, numbers changed on the watch

steps.action: Pick 90 kg x 6 and an effort on the watch, tap 'Done'
user_sees: The set saved on the phone as 90 kg x 6 with that effort
must_not: The phone's grey numbers saved instead
An effort saved on a warm-up

start: Rest card for a set with nothing to save, app in the background

user_sees: A quiet note 'Open MettleUp to log Bench Press, set 3' with what is missing and '— nothing was saved.'

must_not: The app opening on another screen

start: Rest card left from a workout that was finished on the phone

user_sees: 'Open MettleUp to log your set' with 'That rest card was out of date, so nothing was saved.'
must_not: A set added to the finished workout

start: Android closed MettleUp during a rest; the member logs two sets with 'Done' on the watch

steps.action: Tap 'Done' twice on the same card
user_sees: One set saved; the second tap does nothing
Both sets logged from the watch are in the workout, in order, with their own times
must_not: A set saved without telling the member that numbers were missing

start: Phone locked on a table at the gym during a rest

user_sees: The rest countdown and the next exercise name; the countdown channel 'Never makes a sound.'
must_not: Body weight or other private numbers on the lock screen
A sound from the countdown card
